title_hook: Without tension, you make no sound.
concept: The string - slack is free and silent, tension is what sings
theme: Tension is the source of resonance.
quote: The pressure you are begging to remove is the reason you resonate.
core_metaphor: An instrument string: slack equals silence, tuned tension equals sound.
primary_prompt: 9:16 vertical cinematic sequence: a slack gold string lying silent in a black void snaps taut between two black geometric pegs and vibrates with visible standing waves, emitting rings of gold light, holding tension without breaking.

hook.text: You keep asking for less tension. Without it, you make no sound.
hook.visual: 9:16 vertical, black void (#0D0B12): a single gold (#C6A94F) instrument string lying slack and curled on a dark matte surface, motionless. Thin bone-white (#F5F2EB) rim light from the upper left. Absolute stillness. Camera static, top-down.

build.text: A string lying slack on the floor is free. It is also silent. It cannot carry a single note no matter how gently you touch it.
build.visual: Slow macro tracking shot along the slack string: dull, unpolished, coiled. Dust settles on it. A band of light passes over it with no reflection and no vibration. Cold and inert.

pivot.text: Pull it tight, and the same string sings. The pressure you are begging to remove is the reason you resonate.
pivot.visual: The string snaps taut between two black geometric pegs and visible standing waves ripple along its length as it vibrates, emitting rings of gold light into the void. High-speed macro, crisp, electric.

resolution.text: Do not loosen. Tune. Find the tension that holds without snapping, and play inside it.
resolution.visual: Medium shot: the vibrating string glows evenly, tension visible as fine crimson (#DC143C) stress lines near the pegs, but holding. Camera drifts slowly along its length. Controlled, resonant, steady.

mobius_close.text: Because a life with no pull on it is not peace. It is a string that never...
mobius_close.visual: Wide shot: the vibration fades and the frame darkens until the string lies slack again on the dark surface, matching the opening geometry. Silent, unresolved.

caption: A slack string is free. It's also silent. Don't ask for less tension. Learn to tune it.
